verdicts.criticalReason: The PR violates boundaries by committing multiple internal orchestrator files under the `.eneik/` directory. Additionally, the PR introduces out-of-scope backend changes such as Java model classes, JPA repositories, controllers, services, database migrations, and integration tests, which are completely outside of the BARCAN-TAG-11 (Frontend UI) role.
concerns: The spintax highlighter uses raw HTML string manipulation via `@html` in `campaigns/+page.svelte`, which could present XSS vulnerabilities if inputs are not properly sanitized.
The simulated file upload and parsing processes rely on temporary local states instead of robust API error handling and validation.
The newly added backend REST controllers catch raw Exception messages and can potentially leak internal system stack traces.
